programs.title: Naked and Afraid 5
programs.desc: Two unknown people, a woman and a man, are left in a lonely place with difficult climatic conditions.They must spend 21 days there without food, water or clothing.They can only take one item with them.The operators show how daredevils, relying on their own company, learn to cooperate and make key decisions together.Viewers will see that appropriate knowledge and skills can be very useful in extreme moments and even determine survival.

programs.title: Africa Express
programs.desc:
For the first time, the race will take participants through Africa.They will cover the route through Kenya and Tanzania - from the foot of Kilimanjaro, through the crowded streets of Arusha, to the sand dunes by the Indian Ocean and historic Mombasa, ending the competition in Nairobi.Eight couples: Ewa Gawryluk-Domaniecka with her husband Piotr Domaniecki, Edyta Zając with her partner Michał Mikołajczak, Nikodem Rozbicki with her friend Paweł Kurkowski, Wiktoria Gąsiewska with her brother Mateusz Gąsiewski, Tomasz Iwan with her partner Karolina Woźniak, Katarzyna Niezgoda with her husband Paweł Markiewicz, Izu Ugonoh with his wife Antonina Ugonoh and MonikaHoffman-Piszora, together with her sister Iga Hoffman, faces the challenges of harsh, unpredictable nature - lack of roads, difficult access to water and communication, time pressure and their own emotions.The program will be hosted by Iza Krzan.Every day, participants must demonstrate perseverance, cooperation and resilience, learning about completely different faces of Africa.It's a test of boundaries and a lesson in friendship
Participants move from the lands of Tsavo to the majestic Great Rift Valley, where the expedition gains new dynamics.The couple who left the race are given a chance to return, but must remain hidden, traveling without luggage or support.If exposed, they will face elimination.The others face the task of estimating the length of the longest continental trench, fighting for the advantage on the further route to Naivasha, the center of the Kenyan flower industry.There, couples prepare symbolic bouquets to order, testing their floral talents.Fighting for the amulet is Kati's dynamic game, reminiscent of dodgeball.In Nairobi, competitors immerse themselves in the world of colorful matatu minibuses.They must find their driver, learn to dance and engage passengers in having fun together.The finale reveals the secret of the return of the eliminated couple.
